tools.name: search
tools.description: Search National Digital's published pages - services, articles, case studies and pricing - for a topic or keyword. Pages that contain every word rank first, and a word matches as a prefix. Returns up to 20 ranked results (8 by default), each with an id, title, url, type, a short excerpt and the page

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one published National Digital page as clean Markdown, given an id from search (the page's site path, e.g. /systems-integration/) or its full URL. Returns the page's text with its title, canonical url and last-modified date. Long pages are returned in parts; pass the returned nextOffset as offs

tools.name: get_pricing_and_services
tools.description: What National Digital builds and supports, and what each kind of project typically costs, in AUD. tools.name: estimate_project
tools.description: Estimate the cost range for a specific software project. Uses the same calculation as the estimator on the website, so the answer matches what a person would be shown.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Send an enquiry to National Digital on behalf of the person you are helping. Only use this when they have asked you to make contact. A human replies within one business day.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
